categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches unit tests for proof-of-work validation in pow.cpp rather than test framework machinery or harnesses.
categories.rationale: The test infrastructure category explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of a particular area, directing them to that area instead. This PR adds unit test coverage for PermittedDifficultyTransition in pow.cpp to kill a mutant, making it a consensus validation test rather than test machinery.
